symptom: Production Sites version 532 displayed the internal vacation fixture 'המתחם הקטלני של רועי' with room 'test4' and phone 050-1234567 in the homepage last-minute rail.
expected_behavior: Internal QA fixtures must be absent from every public catalog, cached discovery rail, detail path and booking entry.
environment: Observed on https://vii.spaplus.co in Sites version 532, deployment appgdep_6ad7aa2aec28819188014d5f824e12f6. Fixed and independently verified on Sites version 533, deployment appgdep_6ad7b050469c81918a1a11ba1ba01f1e, on 2026-10-20 after the dynamic homepage rail settled.

steps: Open the public homepage in a fresh browser session.
Wait for the last-minute availability rail to replace its loader.
reproduction.evidence: The rendered rail contained the exact internal fixture name, room, phone and ₪100 total while the server-rendered catalog surface excluded it.

observations.observation: The home-deals endpoint accepted cached deals using publishedSupplierIds only and did not intersect them with the filtered public summary set.
A cached availability snapshot can outlive a later catalog-level fixture exclusion.
observations.evidence: Production version 532 returned the fixture only after the dynamic cached availability rail loaded.

hypotheses.mechanism: The last-known-good availability cache retained a supplier deal and the final endpoint filtered only by published supplier ID, bypassing the public catalog fixture predicate.
hypotheses.prediction: The fixture appears in the hydrated availability rail even though public catalog summaries and server-rendered catalog cards exclude it.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare the settled homepage rail with the public catalog guard and trace the home-deals final filtering boundary.
hypotheses.result: Observed exactly: the dynamic rail contained the fixture, publicCatalogSummaries applied the guard, and the endpoint did not intersect cached deals with filtered summaries.

hypotheses.mechanism: Sites deployed the wrong commit or stale frontend assets.
hypotheses.prediction: The production page would lack version 532 assets/configuration and other release changes.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Verify the deployment record, public headers/assets and other version 532 corrections.
hypotheses.result: Deployment 532 succeeded on commit 8aaeab0, production returned the new asset family, aws-aurora origin and the other release corrections; only the cached deal boundary leaked the fixture.

fix.change: Filter freshly generated deals through the shared public fixture predicate and intersect every cached homepage deal with the already-filtered public catalog summary IDs before curation and rendering.
fix.evidence: 13 focused tests, 35 affected-family tests, the production build and the full 1,377-test suite pass locally.

regression_checks.check: Fresh supplier availability cannot add the exact fixture.
Cached deal boundary rejects fixture identities and keeps real places.
Cache, regional expansion and parallel-read contracts remain intact.

regression_checks.evidence: 1,377 of 1,377 tests passed after a clean rerun.

regression_checks.check: Deployed public regression on desktop and mobile.
regression_checks.evidence: Sites version 533 showed real last-minute offers with zero matches for the fixture name, test4 or 050-1234567; no horizontal overflow was observed at 1280x720 or 390x844.
Production capabilities returned 21 entries and a read-only stay quote for siteID 1605, roomID 2877 returned available, total 1400, onlineBooking true without creating a booking.

authorization_boundary: Repair and publish the public VII release only; no real booking, destructive data action, DNS change or server migration.
